reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Atlantic Pool Services. Its a family business based in Plano right where I live. They came recently  and did my Driveway leveling (  Its been sinking slowly due to hot weather and nearby oak tree).
Concrete leveling is another service that Atlantic Pool offers. They were quick and did a clean job .
Daniel  is the owner and he has been wonderful in taking care of my driveway repair and did a follow up visit and a phone call to make sure I was satisfied.
reviews.author: 33ad1 33ad1

reviews.text: Daniel and his team helped renovate our pool and it became a very tough project. The scope was relocating the pool equipment, resurfacing, new tile, coping, mastic and decking. At the beginning of the project we discovered our pool sat on top of a natural spring and had some movement. Daniel and his team stuck with us and guided us through the project. Although the cost went up and the timeline extended due to the conditions, Daniel was calm and knew exactly what to do in the face of some really unique and adverse conditions. Daniel is honest, trustworthy, professional and most importantly - does what he says he will do. I recommend Atlantic Pool Services 100% if you are considering a pool renovation.
reviews.author: Justin Spooner

reviews.text: Hands down the best all around pool service company we've ever worked with. Daniel, Fernanda and their entire team are extremely responsive and so easy to work with. They are always on time and communication is excellent if we are in need of any repair or service. I  would recommend Atlantic Pool Services to anyone looking for a reliable solution.
reviews.author: Jacob

reviews.text: I recently hired Atlantic Pools for a pump replacement, and a filter cleaning. They're professional, punctual, and reasonable. I didn't love the pool service I was getting, so I decided to hire them for weekly services as well. So far so good! I would recommend this business to friends and family.
reviews.author: thascia spindola

reviews.text: Outstanding Personalized Service!!! Working with Atlantic Pool  is like having your own personal Pool Concierge co-designing a pool with you!  Atlantic suggested improved design concept features that minimally affected the cost but resulted in a magnificent outcome! This is not the first pool that we have designed. Yet Atlantic is now our FIRST choice among designers!  They have also impeccable maintained our pool for the last few years since we have lived in our home.  We very highly recommend them!
reviews.author: MARIA V. BOWER, MBA

reviews.text: I have a pool for ten years, and honestly I hated anything about it until I found these guys. I had recurrent issues with algae, equipment breaking here and there, etc. I never mind paying for a professional pool service, but it was hard to find a reliable one. I noticed that my neighbor had the same pool company for years, so I decided to give it a try before I give up on my for good and fill it with mud. For my surprise Atlantic Pool Services did exactly what they say they would. I have been using them for almost 4 years now and I can finally enjoy my pool! I'm not saying that my pool never brakes. Actually, I just had a pump burned out while I was out of town. It was fixed on the very next day, and all communication was made throughout email since I was overseas. What a peace of mind! Thank you Atlantic Pool Services!
reviews.author: Danielle McGarrh

reviews.text: I hired Atlantic Pool Services to take care of my mother's pool. I have been looking for a reliable company with good services, and clear communication for a while. I can say I found that. I would recommend them if that's what you're looking for too.
reviews.author: Zenith Freitas Mundim

reviews.text: Daniel is very reliable and honest. Marcia and Fernanda are great At responding promptly and are very kind! Great Weekly pool service Cleanings and any other pool needs!
reviews.author: Malia Mitchell
